sources.cite: Google Cloud documentation, IAM: Delete and undelete service accounts
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-17. Relevant text: deleting a service account immediately cuts off applications that use it; a new account with the same name is a separate identity that does not inherit the old one's roles; undelete works for 30 days; 'If you're unsure whether anything still uses an account, Google recommends disabling it instead of deleting it.' Disabling a single key (gcloud iam service-accounts keys disable) and the audit log fields are from memory of the key management pages (to verify).
